prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into your existing account syncs and restores all previously adopted desktop companions."}}
1: [home, new_screen] Pet Habitat Customization Waiting Activity Screen: Add an interactive habitat decor setup screen directly following adoption generation waiting so users can customize background decor while waiting for generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_habitat_decor", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Tray Interaction Walkthrough Redesign: Redesign the finish screen into a split view illustrating quick tray shortcuts, pet summoning, and desktop hide/show controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Control your pet easily from your system tray. Click to interact, right-click for settings, or drag to reposition on your screen.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "System Tray Quick Tips: Right-click pet icon to minimize or wake up.", "style": "highlight"}]}}
3: [choose_path, reorder] Direct Path Choice Initial Entry Reorder: Reorder the onboarding experience so users select their path as the first screen upon app launch, moving the story intro immediately after path confirmation.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Lighting & Angle Verification Tip: Add an interactive tip carousel on photo upload advising users on photo lighting, resolution, and single-subject framing to prevent generation errors.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use a well-lit photo with a single clear pet subject for the best customization result.", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Avoid dark or blurry photos to ensure successful pet generation.", "style": "calm", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
5: [home, wait_info] Ambient Relaxing Audio Ambient Selector: Add a sound component on the waiting screen offering background ambient audio themes during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Play Relaxing Waiting Music", "asset": "asset:calm_synth", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
6: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Placement Test Flow: Introduce a desktop rendering verification step at finish where users confirm screen position and visibility before completing onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Verify Desktop Pet Placement", "body": "Let's make sure your pet displays correctly on your desktop display resolution."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_test"]}
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Verification Badge Component: Add an adoption certificate badge component highlighting official pet adoption rights and digital ownership.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Adoption Verified", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Storage Backup Assurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize automatic cloud backup of pet stats and custom settings.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Pet in the Cloud", "body": "Sign in to store your pet's memory, items, and personality safely so you never lose progress."}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Split View Welcome Path Selection Layout: Change choose_path screen layout to split view, showcasing visual preview cards beside companion path choices.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion Path", "body": "Select how you would like to introduce your pet to your workspace."}}

verdicts.reason: Adding an explanatory hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Adding a new habitat decor step during onboarding before home intro is allowed.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout and copy is allowed.
Reordering onboarding steps while preserving all required screens is allowed.
Adding photo advice components to photo upload screen is allowed.
Adding an ambient sound selector component to the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding a new screen after home intro within onboarding is allowed.
Adding a verification badge component to the adoption certificate screen is allowed.
Updating sign-in headline and body copy is allowed.
Changing the layout of the choose_path screen is allowed.
